title: Crazy 4 Poker
betGuide: Choose your ante (steps of 10). An equal Super Bonus comes with it
decideGuide: Your best four of the five play. Raise or fold
acesNotice: A pair of aces or better! You may raise up to 3x
normalNotice: Below aces, so only an equal play bet is allowed
tutorial.bet: Placing the ante also places an equal Super Bonus
tutorial.hand: Your best four of the five dealt cards play
tutorial.multiplier: With a pair of aces or better you may raise to 3x here
frontendHint.crazyFourPokerAces: A pair of aces or better — this is the hand to raise to the cap
frontendHint.crazyFourPokerMinimum: The dealer also needs king high to qualify, so playing beats folding
frontendHint.crazyFourPokerFold: not even king high — folding is the better play
